display.purpose: Hero headline, centred, two lines; Learn index headline, left-aligned.

page-title.purpose: Learn article and topic titles, below the breadcrumb.

section-heading.purpose: Article prose h2 and the 'Try it in Mima' heading.

shadows.name: try-shot
shadows.purpose: Product raster inside the Ube Night Try card (the card's pink pill drops its glow), and the Labs hero figure window on the sleeve.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Every :focus-visible (outline transparent for forced colours). Download: 0 0 0 3px #fff, 0 0 0 6px #e0004a (Ube Night gap on the Try card; Deep Ube ring on the calm band pill).

shadows.name: focus-ring-night

shadows.name: focus-ring-on-lime
shadows.purpose: Links on the lime credits band: a single Ube Night ring.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: State transitions: buttons 0.2s, tab wash 0.3s, word swap 0.35s (width 0.45s), window cross-fade 0.5s.

motion.name: ease-in-out-sine
motion.purpose: Wordmark M draw-on, 350ms, then 'ima' fades in 150ms ease-out. Plays once.

motion.name: quick
motion.purpose: Ink pill opacity/scale and input border.

motion.name: scroll-spy
motion.value: heading past top third of viewport
motion.purpose: Learn 'On this page' marks the section being read (aria-current) with a 0.2s ease-out-expo wash; arrow on 'more' links slides 3px on hover.

motion.name: headline-swap
motion.purpose: Last headline word cycles algorithms/drama/ads once and settles; skipped under reduced motion.

motion.name: showcase-advance
motion.purpose: Feature tab auto-advance; pauses on hover, focus, hidden tab or the pause toggle.

motion.name: compose-zoom
motion.purpose: Compose view zooms into the composer 250ms after selection; upper raster fades to the app ground; text types in at 55ms per character after 900ms. Off at <=600px; reduced motion shows the typed text statically.

motion.name: timeline-scroll
motion.purpose: Catch-up window timeline strip scrolls behind the window chrome; pauses on hover, focus or its pause control; off under reduced motion and at <=600px.

motion.name: caret-blink
motion.purpose: Ube Purple typing caret in the compose view; static under reduced motion.

motion.name: callout-draw
motion.purpose: Labs hero figure: each lime callout stroke draws on once (stroke-dashoffset 1 to 0) and its end dot fades in over 0.3s at 0.85s + i x 0.18s. Under reduced motion the strokes are already drawn.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion collapses all transitions and shows the wordmark statically.

imagery.appShots: Product views are rasters in site-assets/app/*.webp (800x540 @2x plus 780x1040 phone variants, each with a .json provenance sidecar), rendered by app-shots/render.sh (headless Chrome + cwebp) from dummy pages generated by app-shots/build.py with app-shots/app.css (real Ube app styles from mima-social/desktop@next) and fictional content. Those pages document the app's look and are not part of the site system.
imagery.plates: Hero background assets/plates/background.png (generated plate: lilac ground, grainy lime and hot-pink fields, Mima loop squiggle) and left-loop.webp squiggle, each with provenance .json.
imagery.learnTry: The article Try card reuses site-assets/app/feed.webp (News Wall) from the app-shots pipeline; no new rasters.
imagery.labs: Labs hero figures reuse rasters from site-assets/app/ (board.webp, compose-typed-desk.webp) as stand-ins, captioned as such; author photos sit in site-assets/authors/. The sleeve squiggle is an inline SVG stroke, not a raster.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Calm Window"**

Mima's site is a lilac-white room with one big window into the product. The Ube accent scale from the Mima style guide (binding brand source) carries every tint, link, ring and dark band. Two loud brand colours are held back for marketing moments: hot pink for the one action that matters, and lime for spark strokes and dark-ground accents. Everything else stays quiet so the product can do the talking. The page shows the app working, using real-UI rasters inside a rounded window, and does not describe it with feature cards.

Density is generous. Sections breathe on a 64–120px rhythm, copy sits in measured columns (36–40rem leads), and display type is near-black extra-bold grotesque with tight tracking. Depth comes from soft, purple-tinted ambient shadows under the product window and the CTA. There are no hard edges or offset shadows. Corners are round everywhere: 16px on product frames and tiles, 24px on tabs and the video, full pills on every button.

Motion is calm and finite. The wordmark draws on once, the headline's last word cycles once and settles, and the product window cross-fades between views, zooming into the composer to type a post. The only looping motion lives inside the product window and depicts the app: a slowly scrolling timeline and a typing caret, both pausable. All of it collapses under reduced motion, and the page reads fully without it.

Learn (/learn/), the knowledge base, carries the same room into reading. It is a field guide rather than a blog river: topics stand side by side as white 24px shelves, articles read in a 68ch column with a sticky margin holding a fact sheet and an "On this page" list that follows the reader, and every article closes on a "Try it in Mima" card that shows the product. It reuses the lime closing band and onyx footer from the landing page, and adds a compact top bar, Ube Night code blocks and Ube Mist callouts.

Labs (/labs/), the blog, is the same room with more swagger. Every post opens on an Ube Night sleeve that carries the bar, the title and a hero figure, with a lime credits band across the sleeve's foot naming who made the work. Below the sleeve it reads like Learn: lilac ground, the 68ch column, Ube Night code blocks and Ube Mist callouts, with numbered notes in the margin where Learn keeps its fact sheet. The index is a discography: the newest post as a full sleeve, earlier posts as hairline rows.
keyCharacteristics: Lilac-white ground (Ube 50 family) with grainy lime and hot-pink marketing fields at the hero edges only
Near-black extra-bold display, calm UI sans for everything else
One hot-pink pill per viewport; ink pills for secondary actions
Product shown as raster screenshots in a soft-shadowed rounded window
Network logos always in their true brand colours on rounded tiles
Line icons from the Mima icon set (2px stroke, rounded caps), never glyphs or emoji
AI-written text always in MimaSerif italic, labelled as AI
Reading surfaces (Learn) use white 24px cards on lilac and Ube hairline entry rows, never thumbnail card grids

rules.name: The One Pink Rule
rules.body: Hot pink marks the download action, plus the play disc that stands in for the demo. No other element may be pink. If two pink things share a viewport, one is wrong. On Learn the bar's small Download pill is the page's pink, so further Download actions step down: the closing band's Download pill is Ube Night and the topic page's margin uses an ink pill. The one exception is the article's "Try it in Mima" card, whose full Download pill is pink because it sits at the end of the article, a scroll away from the bar. Labs keeps the rule without an exception: the bar's small pill is the only pink on a post or on the index, and the closing band uses the Ube Night pill.

rules.name: The Ube Scale Rule
rules.body: Every tint, ring, link and dark surface comes from the Ube a-50..a-950 scale in the Mima style guide. New purples are not invented. A theme swap redefines the scale, not the components.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Stacked list items (outcomes, AI points, Learn entries, shelf links, fact-sheet rows, table rows) are separated by 1px horizontal hairlines in Ube: a-100 on light grounds, a-700 at 18% on the a-100 ground. No side stripes, no boxed rows.

rules.name: The True Colours Rule
rules.body: Third-party networks appear only in their own brand colours with white marks. They are never tinted to the palette.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: UI text uses only 400 and 600, and display uses only 800. No light, medium or bold-700 in between.

rules.name: The Code Only Rule
rules.body: The monospace stack appears only on code. Labels, dates, counts and meta stay in the UI sans (with tabular numerals where figures align).

rules.name: The AI Voice Rule
rules.body: Text written by a model is set in MimaSerif italic and labelled as AI ("AI summary"). Nothing a person wrote uses the serif, and AI text never appears in the UI sans.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Every heading, button and label is sentence case. No uppercase tracking labels, no eyebrows above headings. Labs carries one owner-pinned exception: a lime category line above the post title. It is sentence case, untracked, 600 at 0.9375rem, and it names the post's category. It is an exception for Labs sleeves, not a pattern for other surfaces.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows are blurred at least twice their offset and tinted to the palette. Hard or offset shadows do not exist in this world.

dos: **Do** take every purple from the Ube a-50..a-950 scale, and use a-700 for any purple text or ring.
**Do** keep hot pink to the single download action (and the demo play disc).
**Do** show the product as real-UI rasters in the rounded, soft-shadowed app window, regenerated through `app-shots/` with fictional content.
**Do** use lime as strokes, icon colour or short text on Ube Night, or a full-bleed band or contained card (the Labs credits band) with ink type, and never as text on light grounds.
**Do** use Mima icon-set line icons (2px stroke, round caps) inline as SVG.
**Do** set AI-generated text in MimaSerif italic (the AI voice) and label it "AI summary".
**Do** separate stacked list items with 1px Ube hairlines.
**Do** give reading surfaces a 68ch column, a sticky fact-sheet margin and hairline entry rows, and set code (only code) in the system mono stack.
**Do** step secondary Download actions down to Ube Night or ink when the bar's pink pill is on the page.
**Do** ease state changes with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) at 0.2–0.5s, and honour reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** use hard, offset or untinted heavy shadows. Lift is soft and palette-tinted.
**Don't** tint network logos to the palette or show them in monochrome tiles (X excepted, which is ink by its own brand).
**Don't** add uppercase eyebrows or kickers above headings, and don't use emoji or glyph icons.
**Don't** use square corners on buttons, tiles or frames.
**Don't** loop decorative motion. Animations play once; repeating motion is allowed only inside the product window, depicting the app, pausable, and stopped under reduced motion.
**Don't** separate list items or flag content with coloured side stripes. Callouts are a tinted block, not a bordered one.
**Don't** build Learn listings as date-sorted thumbnail card grids.
